title: Stamp the ready set with assignee opum-control for routed dispatch
description: opum-control dispatches a task only when that task carries assignee opum-control; a task without it is refused POLICY_DENIED. All 48 tasks in lore-cli's ready set carried no assignee at all, so none could be routed to a dispatch. This is a tracker-only change: set assignee opum-control on each of the 48 tasks that were ready when the stamp was made, touching no other field. Filed so the stamp is itself tracked and its result is verified by reading back on origin/dev.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every task that was ready at stamp time carries assignee opum-control, LCLI-684 included.
No semantic field other than the assignees list changes on any stamped record; the only other delta is the automatically-updated updatedAt timestamp.
The change lands as one tracker-only pull request into dev with the required checks green.
